mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve's likely monetary tightening increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (y/y), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past three months indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,200,000 units annually, it signals weak consumer demand for housing, reducing construction activity and overall economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals contraction in consumer spending amid monetary tightening, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining RSAFS and rising FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100), declining manufacturing output reduces corporate profits and economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
